scope: 阿曼《消费者保护法》（RD 66/2014）与其实施条例（MD 77/2017）下的通用广告、促销与价格、商品说明与标签、语言义务、认证与准入、缺陷与召回；《个人数据保护法》（RD 6/2022，含 2026 年修订提示）下的隐私告知与数据主体权利；海湾低压电器技术法规（GSO BD-142004-01）下的 G-Mark 与符合性文件。品类聚焦小家电、家居用品与 3C 数码。支付/物流/退换（Layer 3）、食品/美妆/玩具、TRA 型号核准（未取得官方英文文本）不在本版范围。
quote_verification: 全部 verbatim_excerpt 均为官方文本子串（去除页眉/页码后做空白归一化，脚本逐条断言通过，40/40）；OM-PRV-07 为 2022 年官方英文译本原文，其 2026 年修订仅有阿拉伯语。
review_policy: decision_level=rule_level 表示可在“法条原文 + 页面原文”同时成立时给出规则级判断；substantiation 表示只能判“需要证明”；human_review 表示需人工/律师复核。review_required=true 的条目必须人工复核后才能进入报告结论；confidence=medium 的条目需在报告中标注不确定性。

sources.name: Consumer Protection Law 66/2014 & Executive Regulations 77/2017 (official English translation, 2nd ed. 2025)
Personal Data Protection Law (Royal Decree 6/2022), official English translation, Official Gazette 1429
GSO Technical Regulation for Low Voltage Electrical Equipment and Appliances (BD-142004-01), English

rules.law_name: Consumer Protection Law (Royal Decree 66/2014) 消费者保护法（苏丹诏令 66/2014）
rules.requirement: 供应商与广告主在营销商品或服务时必须遵守透明与诚信，不得作出虚假或误导性广告或促销活动；判断以整体印象与语境为准，涵盖文案、图片、版式与遗漏。
rules.evidence_needed: 页面快照（桌面/移动）、可见文案与图片、投放渠道与时间、同款表述的历史版本、支撑该表述的检测报告或授权文件。
rules.penalty_or_note: 违反者适用 Art. 40：监禁 3 个月至 3 年，和/或罚款 2,000–50,000 阿曼里亚尔。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: Both the supplier and the advertiser must adhere to transparency and credibility and refrain from engaging in false or misleading advertisements or promotional activities when marketing goods or services to consumers.

rules.law_name: Consumer Protection Law (Royal Decree 66/2014) 消费者保护法（苏丹诏令 66/2014）
rules.requirement: 任何商品不得在未取得主管机关批准前做广告，服务亦然。这是阿曼与马新市场最不同的地方：广告本身是事前审批事项，而不只是事后不得误导。
rules.evidence_needed: 主管机关（CPA / 相关行业主管）对广告或宣传物料的批准文件、批准编号与有效期；投放平台与时间；若为跨境线上广告，需向当地代理/顾问确认审批口径。
rules.penalty_or_note: 违反 Art. 4 适用 Art. 41：罚款 100–5,000 阿曼里亚尔（无监禁）。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: No product shall be advertised, nor any service provided, without obtaining approval from the concerned entity.
rules.notes: “approval from the concerned entity” 的适用范围（是否覆盖品牌自建站、社交媒体贴文、平台 listing）法条未细化，需专业审核。

rules.law_name: Consumer Protection Law (Royal Decree 66/2014) 消费者保护法（苏丹诏令 66/2014）
rules.requirement: 已在商业登记册登记的商业机构，必须在所有函件、发票、商业广告及其他与消费者往来出具的文件上显示其商业登记号（CR）。
rules.evidence_needed: 页面页脚/“关于我们”/发票模板上的 CR 号；与商业登记证的一致性；广告物料是否同样载明。
rules.penalty_or_note: 违反 Art. 6 适用 Art. 41：罚款 100–5,000 阿曼里亚尔。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: Every commercial establishment registered in the commercial register must display its registration number on all correspondence, invoices, commercial advertisements, and any other documents issued when dealing with consumers.

rules.law_name: Consumer Protection Law (Royal Decree 66/2014) 消费者保护法（苏丹诏令 66/2014）
rules.requirement: 供应商不得在未取得主管机关必要许可与批准前开展任何促销活动或降价；主管机关须与 CPA 协调核实价格。
rules.evidence_needed: 促销/折扣的许可或批准文件、批准编号与期限；促销价与促销前实际售价的对应记录；活动页面与落地页截图。
rules.penalty_or_note: 违反 Art. 31 适用 Art. 41：罚款 100–5,000 阿曼里亚尔。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: The supplier is prohibited from conducting any promotional campaigns or discounts on the prices of goods and services without obtaining the necessary licenses and approvals from the competent authority, which shall coordinate with the Authority to verify prices, as specified by the Regulations.

rules.law_name: Executive Regulations of the Consumer Protection Law (Ministerial Decision 77/2017) 消费者保护法实施条例（部长决定 77/2017）
rules.requirement: 开展促销前须：（1）取得主管机关批准（经与 CPA 协调）并向 CPA 提交批准副本；（2）提交促销与广告单页方案；（3）说明奖品、赠品与优惠；（4）说明促销前/后售价并附促销前销售发票。
rules.evidence_needed: 批准文件与 CPA 收件记录、促销方案、奖品清单、促销前后价格与销售发票样本。
rules.penalty_or_note: 违反实施条例的行政罚款上限 1,000 阿曼里亚尔；连续违规每日加处（条例 Art. 43）。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: Before conducting promotions, the Supplier must comply with the following:
rules.notes: 实施条例经 2022 年第 1 号部长决定等修订；本条按 CPA 2025 年第二版英文合并本录入，使用前需与阿拉伯文官报复核。

rules.law_name: Executive Regulations of the Consumer Protection Law (Ministerial Decision 77/2017) 消费者保护法实施条例（部长决定 77/2017）
rules.requirement: 打折前须取得主管机关批准；须提供各品类可打折商品数量清单；须以清晰易读字体标明每件商品打折前与打折期间的售价及折扣百分比；须标明折后价并附打折前的销售发票。
rules.evidence_needed: 批准文件、商品与库存清单、价格历史（含促销排期）、折扣百分比的计算方式、打折前销售发票。
rules.penalty_or_note: 违反实施条例的行政罚款上限 1,000 阿曼里亚尔（条例 Art. 43）。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: A statement of the selling price before and during the sale period for each commodity in a clear and legible font, and the percentage of the discounts.
rules.notes: 同 OM-ADV-05 的版本风险。划线价必须能对应“打折前实际售价”，仅有“原价”字样不足。

rules.law_name: Consumer Protection Law (Royal Decree 66/2014) 消费者保护法（苏丹诏令 66/2014）
rules.requirement: 供应商不得拒绝提供商品/服务、不得限定购买数量、不得搭售其他商品，也不得收取高于广告标示价格的价款。
rules.evidence_needed: 页面标价与结算价/运费/服务费的最终金额截图；加价或搭售的说明；地区/时段差异的明示条款。
rules.penalty_or_note: 违反 Art. 28 适用 Art. 40：监禁 3 个月至 3 年，和/或罚款 2,000–50,000 阿曼里亚尔。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: The supplier is prohibited from refusing to provide a service, selling a good, imposing the purchase of a specific quantity, requiring the purchase of another good along with it, or charging a price higher than the advertised price.

rules.law_name: Executive Regulations of the Consumer Protection Law (Ministerial Decision 77/2017) 消费者保护法实施条例（部长决定 77/2017）
rules.requirement: 禁止以任何方式欺骗或试图欺骗消费者，包括就商品或服务的真实情况、性质、类型、原产地、成分、功效或构成作不实陈述。
rules.evidence_needed: 品牌授权书/采购链路发票、原产地证明、成分或材质报告、型号与批次记录。
rules.penalty_or_note: 行政罚款上限 1,000 阿曼里亚尔（条例 Art. 43）；情节严重时可回到 Law Art. 20/40 的刑责路径。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: To deceit or attempt to deceit the consumer in any way on the reality, nature, type, origin, composition, benefits or components of the commodity or the service.
rules.notes: “original/genuine”类绝对化真伪声称是本条的高频触发点。

rules.law_name: Executive Regulations of the Consumer Protection Law (Ministerial Decision 77/2017) 消费者保护法实施条例（部长决定 77/2017）
rules.requirement: 禁止提供或使用任何虚假、伪造或不准确的证书或声明，作为由主管机构出具的商品或服务质量保证证书。
rules.evidence_needed: 证书原件与签发机构查询结果、证书覆盖的型号与批次、有效期、持证人名称与页面主体是否一致。
rules.penalty_or_note: 行政罚款上限 1,000 阿曼里亚尔（条例 Art. 43）。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: To provide or make use of any fraudulent, fake or inaccurate certificates or statements for commodities or services as quality guarantee certificates provided from competent bodies.
rules.notes: 页面挂 “CE / RoHS / ISO” 徽章时，需核对证书范围与本 SKU 是否对应。

rules.law_name: Executive Regulations of the Consumer Protection Law (Ministerial Decision 77/2017) 消费者保护法实施条例（部长决定 77/2017）
rules.requirement: 禁止广告商品或服务时在其成分、有效成分数量、质量及相关信息上欺骗或误导消费者。
rules.evidence_needed: 规格书、第三方测试报告、成分/容量标注、与广告数字的对应关系。
rules.penalty_or_note: 行政罚款上限 1,000 阿曼里亚尔（条例 Art. 43）。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: To advertise commodities or services that may deceive or mislead the consumer in terms of any of its components, the quantity of useful elements, its quality and relevant information.

rules.law_name: Consumer Protection Law (Royal Decree 66/2014) 消费者保护法（苏丹诏令 66/2014）
rules.requirement: 禁止交易掺假、变质、假冒或未经许可的商品，且此类商品不得做广告。
rules.evidence_needed: 品牌授权、供货链路、真伪鉴定报告、进口许可；页面是否暗示与知名品牌同款。
rules.penalty_or_note: 违反 Art. 7 适用 Art. 40：监禁 3 个月至 3 年，和/或罚款 2,000–50,000 阿曼里亚尔；致人死亡时监禁不低于 5 年。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: It shall be prohibited to trade in any adulterated, spoiled, counterfeit, or unauthorized commodities, and such commodities shall not be advertised.

rules.law_name: Consumer Protection Law (Royal Decree 66/2014) 消费者保护法（苏丹诏令 66/2014）
rules.requirement: 销售二手或瑕疵商品的供应商必须向消费者披露其状况，并在合同或发票中载明。
rules.evidence_needed: 商品状况分级与检测记录、翻新记录、合同/发票上的状况条款、页面标注与实物一致性。
rules.penalty_or_note: 违反 Art. 29 适用 Art. 39：监禁 10 日至 1 年，和/或罚款 100–2,000 阿曼里亚尔。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: A supplier who sells a used or defective good must disclose its condition to the consumer and include this information in the contract or invoice, in accordance with the Regulations.

rules.law_name: Consumer Protection Law (Royal Decree 66/2014) 消费者保护法（苏丹诏令 66/2014）
rules.requirement: 供应商在向消费者提供商品或服务时必须尊重宗教价值、习俗与传统；涉及宗教符号、节庆、服饰、饮食与性别呈现的文案/图案需按当地语境判断。
rules.evidence_needed: 页面图片与文案的完整语境、目标受众、当地文化顾问意见；涉及宗教元素时的授权或说明。
rules.penalty_or_note: 违反 Art. 21 适用 Art. 39：监禁 10 日至 1 年，和/或罚款 100–2,000 阿曼里亚尔。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: The supplier is obligated to respect religious values, customs, and traditions when providing consumers with any good or service.
rules.notes: 文化语境条款，不能靠词表判定；由人工/本地顾问复核。

rules.law_name: Consumer Protection Law (Royal Decree 66/2014) 消费者保护法（苏丹诏令 66/2014）
rules.requirement: 供应商与广告主有义务向消费者提供关于商品或服务的准确信息；“最高可达”“节省 X%”“更安静/更高效”等性能与效益表述，需要可核验的测试依据。
rules.evidence_needed: 对应型号的第三方测试报告（测试条件、基准机型、样本量）、能效或噪音标注、宣称数值的计算口径。
rules.penalty_or_note: 不准确信息可回到 Art. 20 的虚假/误导广告路径（Art. 40：监禁 3 个月至 3 年，和/或罚款 2,000–50,000 阿曼里亚尔）。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: Both the supplier and the advertiser are obligated to provide the consumer with accurate information about the good or service.
rules.notes: 本条只用于判“需要证明”，不判真假。

rules.law_name: Consumer Protection Law (Royal Decree 66/2014) 消费者保护法（苏丹诏令 66/2014）
rules.requirement: 供应商必须以阿拉伯语、以清晰可见的方式在商品上标示：价格、重量、生产日期、保质期、商品名称、成分、原产国、规格编号，以及条例规定的其他信息；可在阿拉伯语之外另加其他语言。
rules.evidence_needed: 实物标签/包装正反面照片、阿拉伯语字段是否齐全、规格编号与标准号、进口商信息。
rules.penalty_or_note: 违反 Art. 19 适用 Art. 39：监禁 10 日至 1 年，和/或罚款 100–2,000 阿曼里亚尔。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: In all cases, the supplier must display, in Arabic and in a clearly visible manner on the product, information regarding the price, weight, production date, expiration date, product name, ingredients, country of origin, and specification number, as well as any other details specified by the Regulations.

rules.law_name: Consumer Protection Law (Royal Decree 66/2014) 消费者保护法（苏丹诏令 66/2014）
rules.requirement: 任何在不当使用时可能危害消费者安全或财产的商品或服务，必须附有阿拉伯语与英语双语、清晰具体的警告，说明正确使用方法及损害补救方式。
rules.evidence_needed: 包装/说明书上的双语警告原文、警示位置与字号、正确使用与急救说明。
rules.penalty_or_note: 违反 Art. 5 适用 Art. 39：监禁 10 日至 1 年，和/或罚款 100–2,000 阿曼里亚尔。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: Any product or service that, when used improperly, may harm consumer safety or property must include a clear and specific warning in both Arabic and English.
rules.notes: 本条是“阿拉伯语 + 英语”双语义务的法条依据；只有英文警告不满足。

rules.law_name: Executive Regulations of the Consumer Protection Law (Ministerial Decision 77/2017) 消费者保护法实施条例（部长决定 77/2017）
rules.requirement: 风险商品的警告、正确使用、预防与补救说明，必须以阿拉伯语和英语两种语言印在包装、外包装或随附说明书上。
rules.evidence_needed: 包装/外包装/说明书照片、双语字段是否同时存在、说明书是否随货。
rules.penalty_or_note: 行政罚款上限 1,000 阿曼里亚尔（条例 Art. 43）。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: Ensure that all information mentioned in (1) and (2) above is written in both Arabic and English on the packaging, outer wrapping, or an enclosed instruction manual.

rules.law_name: Executive Regulations of the Consumer Protection Law (Ministerial Decision 77/2017) 消费者保护法实施条例（部长决定 77/2017）
rules.requirement: 商品或其包装上须清晰标示原产地、性质、类型、基本特征、成分与要素、使用方法与必要预防措施；信息须清晰易读、不易脱落，且阿拉伯语必须是所用语言之一。
rules.evidence_needed: 标签照片（含贴纸材质与可移除性）、阿拉伯语字段、成分与使用说明。
rules.penalty_or_note: 行政罚款上限 1,000 阿曼里亚尔（条例 Art. 43）。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: The information must be written clearly and legibly, in a manner that prevents its removal, and Arabic must be one of the languages used.

rules.law_name: Executive Regulations of the Consumer Protection Law (Ministerial Decision 77/2017) 消费者保护法实施条例（部长决定 77/2017）
rules.requirement: 列入附录 1 的商品（含最大表面面积不超过 10cm² 的小件、家居工具与器皿等）可不直接在商品上印信息，但须以随附说明页载明 Law Art. 19 与条例 Art. 24 要求的信息，且不得违反标准规范。
rules.evidence_needed: 商品尺寸与表面积、随附说明页、零售环节的价签/近商品标示。
rules.penalty_or_note: 行政罚款上限 1,000 阿曼里亚尔（条例 Art. 43）。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: The products listed in Appendix No. (1) attached to these Regulations are considered products that cannot bear written information.
rules.notes: 附录 1 第 3 项：最大表面面积不超过 10cm² 的小件，数据须写在容器上；附录 1 另含家居工具与器皿、手工艺品等。

rules.law_name: Executive Regulations of the Consumer Protection Law (Ministerial Decision 77/2017) 消费者保护法实施条例（部长决定 77/2017）
rules.requirement: 供应商须主动（无论消费者是否索要）提供购买商品或服务的发票；发票必须使用阿拉伯语，可另附一种或多种语言，并载明供应商名称/商号/CR 号、日期、价格与税费、数量、交付信息、签章及保修信息。
rules.evidence_needed: 发票模板与样例、阿拉伯语字段、CR 号与签章、保修条款是否载明。
rules.penalty_or_note: 行政罚款上限 1,000 阿曼里亚尔（条例 Art. 43）。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: The supplier shall provide the consumer with an invoice confirming the purchase of a product or receipt of a service, whether requested by the consumer or not.
rules.notes: 发票语言义务见同条第二句：“The invoice must be in Arabic, and it may be accompanied by one or more other languages.”

rules.law_name: Consumer Protection Law (Royal Decree 66/2014) 消费者保护法（苏丹诏令 66/2014）
rules.requirement: 任何商品在满足全部健康与安全要求、并取得主管机关必要许可或批准前，不得交易；服务同理。
rules.evidence_needed: 进口/经营许可、产品符合性证书、卫生与安全测试报告、主管机关批准编号。
rules.penalty_or_note: 违反 Art. 3 适用 Art. 39：监禁 10 日至 1 年，和/或罚款 100–2,000 阿曼里亚尔。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: No product shall be traded, nor any service provided, before fulfilling all health and safety requirements and obtaining the necessary licenses or approvals from the concerned entity, as specified by the regulation.

rules.law_name: Executive Regulations of the Consumer Protection Law (Ministerial Decision 77/2017) 消费者保护法实施条例（部长决定 77/2017）
rules.requirement: 供应商不得在满足相关法律规定的健康安全条件并取得主管机关许可/批准前交易任何商品或服务，且须满足：符合标准规范、具备实现预期用途的质量要素、不存在危害消费者安全/健康/财产的风险；主管机关要求时须提交经批准的证明报告。
rules.evidence_needed: 标准符合性报告（ISO/IEC 17025 实验室）、许可/批准文件、风险评估、进口商与代理信息。
rules.penalty_or_note: 行政罚款上限 1,000 阿曼里亚尔（条例 Art. 43）。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: The supplier is prohibited from trading in any commodity or providing any service before fulfilling all health and safety conditions stipulated in the relevant laws, regulations and decisions - according to the nature of each commodity or service - and obtaining licenses or approvals from the concerned authorities

rules.law_name: Consumer Protection Law (Royal Decree 66/2014) 消费者保护法（苏丹诏令 66/2014）
rules.requirement: 在不影响其他法定或约定保证的前提下，供应商须确保其商品与服务符合标准规范以及健康、安全与环境要求；无标准规范时须遵守通行标准。
rules.evidence_needed: 所用标准编号（OS/GSO/IEC）与测试报告、环境与安全声称的支撑文件。
rules.penalty_or_note: 违反 Art. 22 适用 Art. 39：监禁 10 日至 1 年，和/或罚款 100–2,000 阿曼里亚尔。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: the supplier is obligated to ensure that the goods and services provided to the consumer comply with standard specifications and health, safety, and environmental requirements.

rules.law_name: Gulf Technical Regulation for Low Voltage Electrical Equipment and Appliances (BD-142004-01) 海湾低压电器技术法规
rules.requirement: 低压电器（交流 50–1000V、直流 75–1500V）在投放海湾成员国市场前，必须符合 BD-142004-01 的安全与电磁兼容要求；符合性经证明后，制造商须出具符合性声明（DoC）并按海湾要求加贴 G-Mark（海湾符合性标志）。
rules.evidence_needed: G-Mark 证书与 DoC、测试报告（IECEE CB 或 GSO 认可实验室）、型号与证书范围的一致性、进口商/代理信息。
rules.penalty_or_note: GSO 技术法规本身未设罚则；阿曼由 MOCIIP/DGSM 按国内法执行（市场监督、下架、召回）。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: Where compliance of electrical equipment with the requirements has been demonstrated, the Manufacturer shall draw up a Manufacturer Declaration of Conformity, and affix the Gulf Conformity Marking in accordance with the relevant gulf requirements related to Gulf Conformity Marking.
rules.notes: GSO 法规文本未载生效日；2016-07-01 为业界与公告常用的 G-Mark 全面执行日（二手来源），需向 DGSM 复核。阿曼自 2025 年起另有 MS-LV 计划（Omani CoC + GSO CoC），本版未取得官方文本。

rules.law_name: Gulf Technical Regulation for Low Voltage Electrical Equipment and Appliances (BD-142004-01) 海湾低压电器技术法规
rules.requirement: 低压电器必须随附阿拉伯语的安全信息，使用说明也须以阿拉伯语提供；进口商同样须确保这一点。
rules.evidence_needed: 阿语说明书与安全信息原件、包装内随附文件、进口商复核记录。
rules.penalty_or_note: GSO 法规未设罚则；由成员国市场监督执行。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: The Manufacturer shall ensure that the electrical equipment is accompanied by safety information in Arabic language, and that the instructions for use are provided in Arabic language.
rules.notes: 与 CPL Art. 5/19 的阿语义务叠加：阿语是硬性要求，英语是“可另加”。

rules.law_name: Gulf Technical Regulation for Low Voltage Electrical Equipment and Appliances (BD-142004-01) 海湾低压电器技术法规
rules.requirement: 制造商须在商品投放市场后保存符合性声明 10 年；主管机关要求时须提供全部符合性文件（原则上阿语，经批准可提交英语），并在不超过 20 个工作日内提供。
rules.evidence_needed: 技术文档与 DoC 归档、保存年限、20 个工作日响应机制。
rules.penalty_or_note: GSO 法规未设罚则；由成员国市场监督执行。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: The Manufacturer Declaration of Conformity shall be kept for a period of 10 years after the electrical equipment has been placed on the market.

rules.law_name: Gulf Technical Regulation for Low Voltage Electrical Equipment and Appliances (BD-142004-01) 海湾低压电器技术法规
rules.requirement: 进口商须确保商品带有 G-Mark 并随附所需文件，且须在商品、包装或随附文件上标明自身名称/商号与可联系地址。
rules.evidence_needed: 包装/随附文件上的进口商名称与地址、G-Mark 位置照片、进口商登记信息。
rules.penalty_or_note: GSO 法规未设罚则；由成员国市场监督执行。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: The Importer shall indicate his name or his registered trade name, and the address at which he can be contacted, on the electrical equipment or on its packaging or in a document accompanying the electrical equipment.

rules.law_name: Consumer Protection Law (Royal Decree 66/2014) 消费者保护法（苏丹诏令 66/2014）
rules.requirement: 供应商发现商品或服务存在可能危害消费者或其财产的缺陷时，须立即停止交易/提供服务，及时通知受影响消费者与相关主管机关（说明缺陷、潜在危害与预防措施），并立即从市场撤回缺陷商品。
rules.evidence_needed: 缺陷发现与处置时间线、召回公告与通知记录、向 CPA 的报告、库存与下架记录。
rules.penalty_or_note: 违反 Art. 27 适用 Art. 40：监禁 3 个月至 3 年，和/或罚款 2,000–50,000 阿曼里亚尔。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: Upon discovering a defect in a good or service that may harm the consumer or their property, the supplier must immediately cease trading the product or providing the service, promptly notify the affected consumers and relevant authorities about the defect, potential harm, and necessary precautionary measures, and immediately withdraw the defective product from the market, in accordance with the Regulations.

rules.law_name: Gulf Technical Regulation for Low Voltage Electrical Equipment and Appliances (BD-142004-01) 海湾低压电器技术法规
rules.requirement: 制造商有理由认为已投放市场的低压电器不符合海湾技术法规时，须立即采取纠正措施使其合规、下架或召回；存在风险时须立即通知其销售所在成员国的国家主管机关，说明不合规情形与已采取的纠正措施。
rules.evidence_needed: 不合格判定与纠正记录、召回/下架证据、向成员国主管机关的通知。
rules.penalty_or_note: GSO 法规未设罚则；由成员国市场监督执行。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: A Manufacturer who consider or have reason to believe that electrical equipment, which he has placed on the market, is not in conformity with the Gulf Technical Regulations in force shall immediately take the corrective measures necessary to bring that electrical equipment into conformity, to withdraw it or recall it, if appropriate.

rules.law_name: Consumer Protection Law (Royal Decree 66/2014) 消费者保护法（苏丹诏令 66/2014）
rules.requirement: 违反 Art. 7、8、20、25、27、28、32 者，处监禁 3 个月至 3 年，和/或罚款 2,000–50,000 阿曼里亚尔；违规致一人或多人死亡时，监禁不低于 5 年。
rules.evidence_needed: 违规条文的对应关系、涉案商品与销售记录、是否有致害后果。
rules.penalty_or_note: 上限：监禁 3 年 + 罚款 50,000 阿曼里亚尔；致死时监禁下限 5 年。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: Anyone who violates Articles (7, 8, 20, 25, 27, 28, 32) of this Law shall be punished by imprisonment for no less than three (3) months and no more than three (3) years, and/or a fine of no less than two thousand (2,000) Omani rials and no more than fifty thousand (50,000) Omani rials.
rules.notes: 罚则写“上限/区间”，不代表必然处罚。

rules.law_name: Consumer Protection Law (Royal Decree 66/2014) 消费者保护法（苏丹诏令 66/2014）
rules.evidence_needed: 违规条文对应关系、页面/标签证据、销售与库存记录。
rules.penalty_or_note: 上限：监禁 1 年 + 罚款 2,000 阿曼里亚尔。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: Anyone who violates Articles (3, 5, 19, 21, 22, 23, 29, 30) of this Law shall be punished by imprisonment for no less than ten (10) days and no more than one (1) year, and/or a fine of no less than one hundred (100) Omani rials and no more than two thousand (2,000) Omani rials.

rules.law_name: Consumer Protection Law (Royal Decree 66/2014) 消费者保护法（苏丹诏令 66/2014）
rules.evidence_needed: 广告/促销批准缺失记录、CR 号缺失、发票语言与内容缺陷。
rules.penalty_or_note: 上限：罚款 5,000 阿曼里亚尔。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: Anyone who violates Articles (4, 6, 24, 26, 31) of this Law shall be subject to a fine of no less than one hundred (100) Omani rials and no more than five thousand (5,000) Omani rials

rules.law_name: Consumer Protection Law (Royal Decree 66/2014) 消费者保护法（苏丹诏令 66/2014）
rules.requirement: 在不影响刑事责任的前提下，CPA 主席可对违反本法或其条例的行为处以行政罚款，单次不超过 1,000 阿曼里亚尔；两年内重复违规加倍；持续违规每日可加处不超过 100 阿曼里亚尔，累计不超过 2,000 阿曼里亚尔。
rules.evidence_needed: 行政处罚决定、违规持续天数、是否属两年内重复违规。
rules.penalty_or_note: 行政罚款上限：单次 1,000；持续违规累计 2,000 阿曼里亚尔。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: The administrative fine shall not exceed one thousand (1,000) Omani rials, and in the event of a repeat violation, the fine shall be doubled.

rules.law_name: Personal Data Protection Law (Royal Decree 6/2022) 个人数据保护法（苏丹诏令 6/2022）
rules.requirement: 发生导致个人数据被破坏、篡改、披露、被访问或非法处理的数据泄露时，控制者须按条例规定的控制与程序，通知 MTCIT 及数据主体。
rules.evidence_needed: 泄露响应流程与演练记录、向 MTCIT 的报告、对数据主体的通知模板与发送记录。
rules.penalty_or_note: 违反 Art. 19 适用 Art. 28：罚款 15,000–20,000 阿曼里亚尔。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: The controller shall notify the Ministry and the personal data subject in case of any breach that leads to destroying, altering, disclosing, accessing, or illegally processing of personal data, according to the controls and procedures specified in the Regulation.

rules.law_name: Personal Data Protection Law (Royal Decree 6/2022) 个人数据保护法（苏丹诏令 6/2022）
rules.requirement: 数据主体有权：撤回同意（不影响撤回前处理）、要求更正/更新/限制、取得已处理数据的副本、数据可携带、要求删除（国家档案与文献目的除外）、以及在数据泄露时获得通知。
rules.evidence_needed: 隐私政策中的权利清单与行使渠道、请求处理 SLA、身份核验流程、撤回同意与删除的实际操作记录。
rules.penalty_or_note: 权利条款本身未单列罚则；拒绝履行可能落入 Art. 13/15 等义务条款的罚则路径。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: Revoke consent to processing of their personal data, without prejudice to the processing that took place prior to the revocation.

rules.law_name: Personal Data Protection Law (Royal Decree 6/2022) 个人数据保护法（苏丹诏令 6/2022）
rules.requirement: 控制者须制定处理个人数据时遵守的控制与程序，至少包括：识别数据主体可能面临的风险、数据传输的程序与控制、确保依法处理的技术与程序措施，以及条例规定的其他控制。
rules.evidence_needed: 数据处理活动记录（ROPA）、风险评估、传输机制、技术与组织措施文档。
rules.penalty_or_note: 违反 Art. 13 适用修正后的 Art. 27：罚款 5,000–10,000 阿曼里亚尔。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: The controller shall set the controls and procedures that shall be adhered to when processing personal data, and they shall include, in particular, the following:
rules.notes: 条款为原则性要求，充分性需人工/律师判断。

rules.law_name: Personal Data Protection Law (Royal Decree 6/2022) 个人数据保护法（苏丹诏令 6/2022）
rules.requirement: 控制者须任命个人数据保护官（DPO）；条例规定该人选的选任标准与职责。
rules.evidence_needed: DPO 任命文件、联系方式是否在隐私政策中披露、向 MTCIT 的备案（如要求）。
rules.penalty_or_note: 违反 Art. 20 适用 Art. 26：罚款 1,000–5,000 阿曼里亚尔。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: The Controller shall appoint personal data protection officer , and the Regulation shall designate the controls of selecting this officer and their duties.

rules.law_name: Personal Data Protection Law (Royal Decree 6/2022) 个人数据保护法（苏丹诏令 6/2022）
claim_pattern: share your data with third parties
rules.requirement: 除依条例取得数据主体事先同意外，控制者须确保个人数据的保密性，不得披露。
rules.evidence_needed: 第三方共享清单与同意记录、数据处理协议、披露目的与范围。
rules.penalty_or_note: 违反 Art. 21 适用 Art. 28：罚款 15,000–20,000 阿曼里亚尔。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: Except by prior consent from the Personal Data Subject as determined by the Regulation, the Controller shall ensure the confidentiality of personal data and shall not disclose it.

rules.law_name: Personal Data Protection Law (Royal Decree 6/2022) 个人数据保护法（苏丹诏令 6/2022）
rules.requirement: 控制者可依条例规定的控制与程序向阿曼境外传输个人数据；但若数据系违规处理取得，或传输可能损害数据主体，则禁止传输。
rules.evidence_needed: 跨境传输的目的国、接收方与保障措施、数据来源合规性、传输影响评估。
rules.penalty_or_note: 违反 Art. 23 适用 Art. 29：罚款 100,000–500,000 阿曼里亚尔（本法最高罚则档）。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: the Controller may transfer personal data and permit transferring it outside the borders of the Sultanate of Oman in accordance with the controls and procedures provided for by the Regulation.

rules.law_name: Personal Data Protection Law (Royal Decree 6/2022) 个人数据保护法（苏丹诏令 6/2022）
rules.requirement: 控制者在向数据主体发送任何具有商业目的的广告或营销材料前，须取得其同意；具体控制与程序由条例规定。（2026 年第 68 号苏丹诏令已把“书面同意”改为“明确同意”，官方英文译本尚未更新）
rules.evidence_needed: 营销订阅的同意记录（勾选、时间戳、来源）、同意与发送清单的对应关系、退订机制与执行记录。
rules.penalty_or_note: 违反 Art. 22 适用 Art. 26：罚款 1,000–5,000 阿曼里亚尔。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: The controller shall obtain written consent from the personal data subject before sending any advertising or marketing material with commercial purposes to them, in accordance with the provisions set forth in the Regulation.
rules.notes: 引用为 2022 年官报英文译本（Official Gazette 1429）原文。RD 68/2026（官报 1664，2026-09-06）以“explicit consent（الموافقة الصريحة）”替换本条；该修订目前只有阿拉伯语，且 PDF 文本层编码损坏，无法逐字转录，故本条的现行措辞需人工比对阿语官报后确认，报告中不得直接引用英文原句。
